title: Completely Inaccurate
text:
10:50 pm Michigan it sent an alert saying moon is setting . It is completely wrong. The moon is NOT setting right now in Michigan. It is currently above the horizon. 
The specific times for moonrise and moonset in your location for today, Wednesday, November 26, 2025, are:
Moonrise: 12:22 PM EST
Moonset: 9:34 PM EST 
Since the current time is after the moon has risen and before it has set, the moon is currently visible in the sky (weather permitting).

title: Bogus golden hour times.
text: Your AM golden hour time starts at the same time as sunrise and the PM time ends at sunset.

title: Notifications don’t work at all
text: I have checked all my settings repeatedly and I have not had a single notification. I made sure my iOS & the app are up to date. It’s very frustrating. It looks like the app has some good information, but I only remember to look at it when I get a notification from my other moon phase app. Regretting my purchase.

title: Cool layout, but inaccurate
text: I like alot of things about the app, but I just cant give it 4 or 5 stars when the most basic info is ALWAYS wrong. Check this against any online astrology/zodiac calendar and you’ll see that this app is always 1 or 2 zodiac signs OFF for the moon phase.  Seems absurd to get this info wrong. It COULD’VE been a contender. Alas, it falls short and after paying for the pro version, I now have to move on to a different app that will be zodiac reliable. Sigh*

title: Missing watch complication
text: The difference between this paid version and the free version is a watch app including complications.  This version has no complications therefore what did I pay for?   Fail

title: Ok
text: Cool app but not worth the “upgrade”

title: Minimal
text: Nice, dry design. But why no mention of lunar eclipses? Or the names of the moons?

title: What Kind of Moon am I
text: The only complaint is I don’t know the name of the monthly moons. October is the Harvest Moon but no where can I find info on this app. Otherwise it’s very good. Add moon names and info and it’s a 5 Star app.
